Predator P bounded in strip, N has logistic upper control (for biological 0<=m<=1, upper r1; otherwise max(1,m) suffices). Outside, positive denominator zeros N=K/(delta P-1) and (c+eP)/(delta P-1) refute whole-quadrant regularity. Independent symbolic rational check gives witness delta=1/5>3/50, Pdot(1,5)=7/2; source baseline delta=.05<=.25.
